messages:
maria: Morning — proposing a 'safe-sweep' to change the default quota for the `slow-gen` route. Idea: shadow->cohort->ramp with telemetry gates. Ops + platform signoff?

sam: quick q — why a sweep rather than targeted cohorts only?

maria: cohorts are fine for individual customers, but we need a way to update global defaults and ensure console & API preview behavior is consistent. Sweep lets us roll a single config change across routing shards and backfill caches.

jordan: +1 on telemetry gating. Metrics to watch: p99 latency, 5m error-rate, reject-rate (quota hits). If any exceed thresholds we pause.

neha: can we do shadowing first (log-only) so we can see behavior w/o affecting users?

alex: ops note — we need an emergency pause button in the console and a deploy-bot hook that can auto-revert if error-rate > 0.5% for 5m. Also need runbook steps for manual rollback.

maria: proposed rollout plan (high level):
1) Shadow 100% for 24h (dry-run).
2) Cohort 2% for 2h, monitor.
3) If green, 10% for 4h, then 100%.
Also attach sampling traces and cost deltas to telemetry.

sam: API / console changes: I'd like a preview endpoint so SEs can validate before promotion. Sketch: `/v1/config/preview` that accepts scope + changes + dry_run flag. Example payload:
```json
{
  "action":"preview",
  "scope":"route:slow-gen",
  "changes":{"quota_per_minute":2000},
  "dry_run":true
}
```

jordan: add a derived metric: delta_cost_per_1k_tokens and token-throttle-rate. Both should appear in the rollout dashboard.

neha: also add runtime flag field: `rollback_on_signal:true` and `owner:ops` so the system auto-triggers rollback when necessary.

alex: owners: who is coordinating? maria? ops watches the first 2 hours. platform team will ship the preview endpoint and console toggle.

maria: volunteering to coordinate. I'll prepare a pre-flight checklist. Can someone add console coachmarks for the pause button so SREs know where to hit?

sam: don't forget audit logs: who initiated the sweep, job id, and full diff. We should surface that in the rollout UI.

jordan: also need a shadow->promote helper script: `promote_shadow_to_live --config-id XYZ --verify-metrics` that runs the checks and optionally promotes.

deploy-bot: :robot_face: created job `rb-sweep-3623` with automatic rollback if `error_rate > 0.005` over 5m. See https://internal.rw/ops/jobs/rb-sweep-3623

neha: I'll add the console UX notes and coachmarks. Also will add the runbook link to the job.

maria: tentative schedule: Thursday 10:00 UTC. Pre-flight checklist posted to #runbooks by EOD tomorrow.

alex: ops will be oncall that window. pls ping pager for any >= Sev2.

sam: small ask — add a `dry_run_reason` free-text on preview so reviewers know intent.

jordan: final: include a smoke query set (3 prompts) to validate model behavior under new quota.

maria: great — I'll assemble everything and post the runbook. thanks all :heart:
